achievements.name: Nowhere To Run To
achievements.description: Take out an invading Julianna while playing as Colt.

achievements.name: All The Live-Long Day
achievements.description: Survive all 4 time periods in one day.

achievements.name: Chop Chop
achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies with the machete in 10 seconds.

achievements.name: Pieces Of Eight
achievements.description: While playing as Colt, kill Frank. Or Charlie. Or Fia. Or Wenjie. Or Aleksis. Or Harriet. Egor will do as well.

achievements.name: Dead Drop
achievements.description: Absorb Residuum from a body - like some kind of temporal sponge.

achievements.name: Residual Earnings
achievements.description: Absorb more than 20000 Residuum in a map.

achievements.name: Forever Yours
achievements.description: Infuse a Slab.

achievements.name: Clean Sweep
achievements.description: Kill everyone in a time period and escape.

achievements.name: Sugar Crash
achievements.description: While playing as Colt, use candy to gain a tactical advantage.

achievements.name: Know Your Enemy
achievements.description: Complete one AEON dossier.

achievements.name: Oops
achievements.description: While playing as Colt, cause someone to fall to their death.

achievements.name: Ensemble Tragedy
achievements.description: Kill each Visionary at least once.

achievements.name: Bling Bling Bang Bang
achievements.description: Equip a loadout worth more than 45100 Residuum.

achievements.name: Nowhere To Hide
achievements.description: While playing as Julianna, cross Colt off your kill list.

achievements.name: Spare No Expense
achievements.description: While playing as Colt, own all upgrades for a Slab.

achievements.name: Rip And Tear
achievements.description: As Colt, inflict a truckload of damage to Eternalists during a single use of Havoc.

achievements.name: Blink Of An Eye
achievements.description: As Colt, transport an enemy onto a mine using Shift.

achievements.name: Fwd: Fwd: Fwd: PAIN
achievements.description: As Colt, transmit damage over more than 20 meters using Nexus.

achievements.name: Death Is In The Air
achievements.description: As Colt, achieve 3 airborne headshots on enemies you've launched using Karnesis.

achievements.name: Don't Mind Me
achievements.description: While using Aether as Colt, kill 3 enemies without alerting nearby enemies.

achievements.name: Dressing Down
achievements.description: As Julianna, disguise yourself as Colt using Masquerade.

achievements.name: For Every Occasion
achievements.description: Take 36 different Trinkets into the field with you while playing as Colt.

achievements.name: Spoiled for Choice
achievements.description: Infuse one of each type of weapon.

achievements.name: The Spice Of Life
achievements.description: Die every which way as Colt: Drown. Fall. Choke on poison gas. Succumb to fatal depressurization. Get blown up. Shot. Stabbed. Ground up. Fried by a rocket. Oh, and obliterated by a reactor. Fun, right?

achievements.name: Full Deck
achievements.description: Kill a Visionary using a full loadout, without any empty slots or sockets, and escape the map.

achievements.name: The G.O.D. of O.S.P.
achievements.description: Enter a map with an empty loadout and kill all Visionaries present. Leave the map. Wash your hands.

achievements.name: Mightier Than The Gun
achievements.description: Kill all Visionaries in a map - and make it to the exit - without using a gun.

achievements.name: Silent Disco
achievements.description: Get in and out of a map without being spotted - and kill all Visionaries present.

achievements.name: Only The Guilty
achievements.description: Kill all Visionaries present in a map and escape without killing any Eternalists.

achievements.name: You Only Die Once
achievements.description: Finish an entire loop while wearing a ClassPass.

achievements.name: Play It Again, Colt
achievements.description: After finishing the game once, kill all Visionaries in a map and escape.

achievements.name: Clean-ish Hands
achievements.description: Kill all Visionaries - and no Eternalists - in a single loop.

achievements.name: A Charlie Montague Game
achievements.description: Prove you're a real gamer by winning Charlie's Wake Up Challenge, Reward Scheme, the Moxie, Haul-A-Quinn, and the Yerhva.

achievements.name: Cooking With Gas
achievements.description: While playing as Colt, ignite a gas cloud while someone is inside it.

achievements.name: Deathday Suit
achievements.description: Kill the (mostly) naked character in each map.

achievements.name: Garbage Day!
achievements.description: Kill the Garbage Collector and acquire the Fugue slab.

achievements.name: Out Like a Light
achievements.description: Acquire the HALPS Prototype and disintegrate a Visionary.

achievements.name: Best of Both Worlds
achievements.description: Use the experimental machine in Karl's Bay to craft a doubly-powerful trinket.

achievements.name: Postmodern Abstractionism
achievements.description: Kill an Eternalist with a Paint Bomb.
